name: description
description: Human-readable explanation of what the row or field represents.

name: draggable
description: Whether the panel can be reordered in the editor.

name: editable
description: Whether the user can change the value.

name: enabled
description: Whether the panel is enabled by default.

name: example
description: Sample value used to clarify intent.

name: id
description: Unique row identifier for the record or definition.
notes: Used across inputs, panels, and pages.

name: label
description: Human-readable input label shown in the UI.

name: notes
description: Implementation notes edge cases or extra context.

name: order
description: Sort order used when rendering or listing rows.

name: path
description: Unique logical storage path using dot notation.

name: readonly
description: Whether the panel can be edited by the user.

name: reference
description: Reference to another row id used for inheritance reuse or dependency.
notes: Use when one row depends on or mirrors another.

name: repeatable
description: Whether this is an object or array in the code.

name: required
description: Whether the record or field must exist to be considered valid.
notes: Used by inputs, panels, and pages.

name: title
description: Title shown in the UI.

name: visibility
description: Controls whether something is shown hidden or conditionally shown.
notes: Used by both inputs and panels. Pages may also use it later if needed.

name: input
description: UI control used to capture or edit the value (NOTE: use the `<Input>` component for all `<input>` related elements. The other 'form' components will be created later so it's ok to use normal html for those.
options: text, textarea, select, multiselect, date, datetime, number, email, tel, url, file, image, checkbox, radio, repeater, richtext, hidden

name: options
description: Allowed options when the input uses select-like controls.

name: outputToPages
description: Pages that consume this input during rendering.
options: Cover, Table of Contents, Introduction, Project Report, Personnel in Attendance, Cargo Description, Cargo Condition Inspection, Time Log, Cargo Operations, Cargo Damages, Cargo Storage, Cargo Trailer Securement, Ships Particulars, Ships Certifications, Barge Information, Lifting Plan, Lifting Gear, Stowage Plan, Post-Discharge Inspection, Disclaimer

name: outputToPageSection
description: Page region where the input is rendered.

name: panel
description: Panel this input belongs to in the editor.
notes: Join target for the panels sheet.
options: Organization, Project, Team, Client, Facility, Carrier, Items, Inspection, Damages, Discharge, Time Log, Custom

name: placeholder
description: Hint text shown before the user enters a value.

name: source
description: Where the value comes from.
options: user, system, prefilled, derived, template, external

name: type
description: Actual stored data type for the value.
options: string, number, boolean, date, datetime, enum, object, array, file, image, richtext

name: validation
description: Validation rules such as min max pattern or format.
options: required, min, max, minLength, maxLength, pattern, email, url, phone, date

name: value
description: Initial default value used when creating a new record.

name: entity
description: Dataset this instruction row applies to.
notes: Used only by the instructions sheet itself.

name: name
description: Exact column name this instruction row describes.
notes: Used only by the instructions sheet itself.

name: type
description: Expected value type for the named column.
notes: Used only by the instructions sheet itself.
options: system, string, number, boolean, list, object, array, any, image, url

name: page
description: Name of the output page.
options: Cover, Table of Contents, Introduction, Project Report, Personnel in Attendance, Cargo Description, Cargo Condition Inspection, Time Log, Cargo Operations, Cargo Damages, Cargo Storage, Cargo Trailer Securement, Ships Particulars, Ships Certifications, Barge Information, Lifting Plan, Lifting Gear, Stowage Plan, Post-Discharge Inspection, Disclaimer

name: section
description: Page regions enabled for the page layout.

name: variant
description: Render variant used for the page.
options: full, toc, list, template, team, table, photo

name: icon
description: Emoji to use for icon. Will later be replaced with icon class name.

name: iconClass
description: CSS class or token used to render the panel icon.

name: iconUrl
description: Optional icon or asset URL associated with the panel.

name: type
description: Panel behavior or rendering variant if needed.
notes: Optional for now; current data allows this column even if blank.
